players.product: We Energies electric service and new generation for the Microsoft (Mount Pleasant / Pleasant Prairie) and Vantage Lighthouse (Port Washington) data-center campuses

connects_to.relationship: electric service and a dedicated electricity rate for Vantage's Lighthouse campus in Port Washington (1.3 GW of demand forecast through 2030)

contracts.signal: WEC's 10-Q: Vantage Data Centers is developing a large data center campus in Port Washington forecast to add 1.3 GWs of demand through 2030, with the potential to add an incremental 2.2 GWs (up to 3.5 GWs over time); WEC is working closely with these large customers to provide power to meet the projected demand.
contracts.units: 1.3 GWs of demand through 2030; up to 3.5 GWs over time
